kpis.name: High turnovers
kpis.description: Number of possessions lost (failed passes, bad ball touches or lost attacking duels) in own 40% of the pitch adjusted by possession.

kpis.name: Losses
kpis.description: Number of actions that end the possession of a team (passes, offensive duels, touches) adjusted by possession.

kpis.name: Pressure resistance %
kpis.description: Percentage of successful actions under pressure in the first or second thirds of the pitch.

kpis.name: Under pressure retention
kpis.description: Number of successful actions under pressure in the first or second thirds of the pitch adjusted by possession.
